paper.title: NQS-Agent: Health-Aware Agentic Hyperparameter Optimization for Neural-Network Quantum States
paper.authors: Jia-Qi Wang, Xiao-Qi Han, Ze-Feng Gao, Rong-Qiang He, Zhong-Yi Lu

results.system_description: J₁–J₂ Heisenberg, 10 × 10 · J₂/J₁ = 0.5 · periodic · Sz = 0. H = J1 sum_<ij> S_i · S_j + J2 sum_<<ij>> S_i · S_j; spin-1/2 operators; J1 = 1; J2 = 0.5
results.method: Residual convolutional NQS (aCNN family), agentic hyperparameter optimization
results.source_location: Table tab:hpo_results, row 'A5, LR = 0.005, seed 8', column J2/J1 = 0.5
results.eligibility_evidence: Final variational energy per site of a promoted HPO candidate (settings without a reported final value are 'Not promoted' or failed); the aCNN human-tuned baseline row is arXiv:2308.09664, already on Ketboard.
results.notes: 10 x 10 lattice with periodic boundary conditions (Sec. 'Benchmark Task'). Only the amplitude is represented ('real-valued amplitude sector'); the sign structure is the fixed one of the aCNN implementation of arXiv:2308.09664 (Marshall sign rule, approximate for J2 != 0). The magnetization sector is not stated.
